items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Papa... Frownin' George and Ram used to room with Papa Mutt.

ctx.x: And he'd knock off the numbers and tell you what to play and all this?

Oh yeah. Once in a while, we'd... Well, Mutt was one of them kind of...a con man himself. Papa... Frownin' George and Ram used to room with Papa Mutt. Papa Mutt was living out there in Boyle Heights. Because Papa Mutt married a Mexican woman, see, and all them Mexicans lived in Boyle Heights. I'll never forget... Some things I'll never forget. They lived on a little old street called Cheesebrough Lane, and Papa Mutt would say, "Well, we'll have a rehearsal, and I'm gonna have a pot of beans." And mostly he wanted…
Did you rehearse with the band at all, or was it...?
